text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Overdose of BEVYXXA increases the risk of bleeding [see Warnings and Precautions (5.1) ] . A specific reversal agent for BEVYXXA is not available. There is no experience with hemodialysis in individuals receiving betrixaban. Protamine sulfate, vitamin K, and tranexamic acid are not expected to reverse the anticoagulant activity of betrixaban.
